_comment: Frontage-change slot pairing (drill mode -- a lone Spearmen regiment, no opponent, so nothing but the reform moves anyone): select the block, then widen it three files with ] ] ]. The point is WHICH man walks to WHICH new cell. A file-major block used to hand soldier i the file and the depth his ARRAY INDEX named, and renumbering the files sends almost every index somewhere else, so even a three-file nudge scattered the whole block onto long diagonal routes. Each man now takes the file nearest him and keeps his depth order within it, so the block simply breathes outward a few world units and settles. The frontage change is deliberately small: the block's shape barely changes, which leaves the men's ROUTES as the only thing to look at. Driven live through the real SelectionManager by tools/demo/DemoInputRecorder.gd; world coordinates; physics ticks (60/s).
